verdicts.why: The check performs the repeated restriction with the current revision, requires an accepted customer answer marked unchanged, and compares the returned and persisted Customer with the pre-repeat restricted record, thereby preserving its revision and all other fields. It also requires the audit log and entire store to remain unchanged and checks that neither the answer nor audit log gains a confirmation id.
